  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Clean the {{ing_01|paunch of a suckling pig}} well with {{ing_02|salt}} and {{ing_03|vinegar}} and presently wash with {{ing_04|water}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Then fill it with the following dressing: {{ing_05|pieces of pork}} pounded in the mortar, {{ing_06|three brains}}—the nerves removed—mix with {{ing_07|raw eggs}}, add {{ing_08|nuts}}, {{ing_09|whole pepper}}, and {{ing_10|sauce}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_11|pepper}}, {{ing_12|lovage}}, {{ing_13|silphium}}, {{ing_14|anise}}, {{ing_15|ginger}}, {{ing_16|a little rue}}; fill the {{ing_01|paunch}} with it, not too much, though, leaving plenty of room for expansion lest it bursts while being cooked."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Put it in a pot with boiling {{ing_04|water}}, retire and prick with a needle so that it does not burst."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When half done, take it out and hang it into the smoke to take on color."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Now boil it over again and finish it leisurely."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Next take the {{ing_17|broth}}, some {{ing_18|pure wine}} and {{ing_19|a little oil}}, open the {{ing_01|paunch}} with a small knife."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "Sprinkle with the {{ing_17|broth}} and {{ing_12|lovage}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "text": "Place the pig near the fire to heat it, turn it around in {{ing_20|bran [or bread crumbs]}} immerse in [sprinkle with] {{ing_21|brine}} and finish [the outer crust to a golden brown]."
    }
  ],
